newsitem.headline: TABLE - Interpublic Group Q2 shr $1.09.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES: (a)1996 includes net income of $8.08 million or $0.10, pre-split EPS and $0.07 post-split EPS from sale of a portion of CKS Group stock in the quarter and six months.

Earnings per share for the second quarter of 1997 were $1.09 versus $0.94 in 1996, excluding the gain on the CKS Group stock sale. Currency impacted net income for the quarter unfavorably by 3.5 percent.
Net income for the first six months of 1997 excludes the gain on the stock sale. Currency impacted net income for the period unfavorably by 4.0 percent.

Taking into account a three-for-two stock split on July 15, 1997, earnings per share on a comparable basis, excluding the gain on the stock sale, were $0.73 for the second quarter of 1997 versus $0.62 for the similar quarter in 1996. For the six months, earnings per share were $0.91 versus $0.77.
